Back to the board

Patch notes

What has changed in mbrd, newest first. The things worth knowing about, rather than every commit.

33 releases 340 commits since 24 July 2026

  1. 8

    0.297 - 0.304

    Well Connected

    12 September 2026

    • The lines between cards were rebuilt, photos grew a lighter stand-in, and link cards say more. A day spent on the board's plumbing.

    The lines between cards

    • NewConnection lines were rebuilt. A line leaves and arrives on whichever side of each card is nearest, finds its way around the cards between it with clean right-angled bends rather than a staircase, and wears the look of the whimsy dial. Several lines meeting one card fan across its edge instead of stacking, and a line you draw by dragging keeps the curve it had under your hand.
    • FixThe "Cannot join" mark is gone. The rebuilt router reaches a side of every card, so the round badge that used to pin over a card and announce the pairs it could not connect has nothing left to report.

    Photos and the Feed

    • NewEvery photo keeps a lighter display copy, about a thousand pixels on its long side, which is what the board and the Feed now draw. An older board has the copies filled in the first time it opens.
    • NewA card shows its full original when you zoom right in, and drops back to the light copy when you zoom out - so a close look stays sharp without the whole board carrying full-size pictures.
    • FasterThe Feed keeps up on a big board. It draws only the tiles in view and fills them in as you scroll, each picture set to fill or fit its tile rather than all of them decoded at once.

    Link cards

    • NewPlayer and brand cards say more. A card fetches the page's own title, names the Steam game or the Reddit community it points at, and shows the X logo where a link leads there.
    • NewA link card's menu leads with Edit and Copy link, and every link out of the app asks once before it takes you off the board.
    • FixA pasted player link arrives the right size, at the least a player needs rather than the smaller default a plain link uses.

  5. 19

    0.273 - 0.291

    A Window of Its Own

    6 September 2026

    • mbrd is an app you can install now. The board in the browser is unchanged and is still the whole of it. What the desktop adds is a window of its own, your boards where you can see them, and three jobs a tab is not allowed to do.

    Installing

    • Newmbrd installs on Windows, macOS and Linux. One Setup.exe asks on a page of its own whether to install or to leave a portable copy, a .dmg for macOS and an .AppImage for Linux. /download has the three, and says plainly what your computer will say about an app nobody has paid to sign yet, and what to do about it.
    • NewA .mbrd file opens by double-clicking it. The title bar says which board is open, a menu bar carries the app's own commands, and a second file opens in the window already running rather than starting another.
    • NewNew versions arrive on their own and install when you quit. A note says which version will install when you close the app, and then nothing happens until you do. A portable copy and an unsigned macOS build say they cannot replace themselves rather than offering a button that fails.

    What the desktop does that a tab cannot

    • NewYour boards are a folder, not a browser's storage. They sit in %APPDATA%/mbrd and its equivalents, and a portable copy keeps them in data beside the program. A browser may clear its own storage to make room; a folder stays where you put it.
    • NewOptimize does video on the desktop. It is the first thing this app can do there and cannot do in a tab. ffmpeg is a program sitting beside the app rather than a 32 MB download into a page.
    • FasterRemove background is close to instant on the desktop - 13 milliseconds against a couple of seconds in a browser, once the model has loaded the first time.
    • NewAdd files offers every format mbrd knows - twelve groups, from pictures and sound to 3D and CAD, archives, maps and disk images - where it had offered only the four kinds the app can draw.

    Off This Machine

    2 September 2026

    • A board can be shared as a link, and kept in your own Google Drive.
    • NewShare link puts the board in your Drive and copies a link anybody can open. Keep this board copies it to your account and keeps it up to date from then on, Open from cloud opens it on another machine, Sync now sends whatever has changed, and Stop syncing leaves the stored copy where it is.
    • The app asks for the one permission that reaches files it put there itself, and for nothing else in your Drive.

  10. 6

    0.258 - 0.263

    Under the Hand

    22 August 2026

    • Mostly a release about what the app does when you touch it: a press that is answered, a menu that leaves the way it came, a board that steps back while you follow a thread across it. Two tools also stopped guessing, and the tour is built somewhere else entirely.

    Touch and menus

    • NewEvery button answers a press, and a tapped one stops staying lit afterwards. On a touch screen the browser answers hover from the last tap and leaves it standing, so a tool pressed once looked chosen until something else was.
    • NewMenus leave the way they arrive. Find, the right-click menu, the toolbar's flyouts, the fence offer and the connection chip all used to appear and then simply vanish. Each plays its way out now, and a flyout opens from the middle of the button that opened it rather than from its corner.

    The tour, and following a thread

    • NewThe tour is built on the board. Every card carries a small square in its corner - a number if it is at that stop, a + if it is not - and a bar along the foot holds the order and a caption for each stop. It used to be a list in a panel covering the third of the board you were picking cards from.
    • NewFollowing a card's threads steps the rest of the board back. Hovering a card used to drop every line that was not its own. The cards those lines reach stay as they are and everything else goes quiet - enough to separate, not enough to hide.
    • FixA connection finds its way around the cards between its ends, where it used to settle on a side before looking and send a line behind a card.
    • FixThe connect tool puts itself down after a pair, with Shift keeping it up. It stayed armed before, which every first-time hand read as the app having got stuck.

    The two tools that stopped guessing

    • NewRemove background finds the subject, rather than filling inwards from the edges against their average colour. A card cut out this way is cut out in the exported picture too.
    • NewCAD files draw properly. .iges and .igs are read at all now, and they and .step go through a real CAD kernel rather than this app's own reading of their surfaces, so a curved part arrives curved.
    • FixA cut-out card stops growing its background back when you zoom out.

  12. 11

    0.242 - 0.252

    Face Up

    17 August 2026

    • A release about cards that used to be blank. A great many files that dropped in as a grey rectangle with a name now show their own picture, and the clips that would not preview at all finally do.

    Files that show their own picture

    • NewDocuments and design files show the thumbnail they were saved with. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote and OpenDocument files, the older .doc, .xls and .ppt, and Visio, Krita, Procreate, SolidWorks and 3ds Max files besides.
    • NewPrograms and app packages show their own icon. A Windows .exe or .dll, an Android .apk, an iOS .ipa, a Windows .appx, an ebook, a comic or a 3D-print package shows its icon or its cover.
    • NewCamera RAW and HEIC photos show a real image. The app pulls out the preview the camera tucked inside, so a folder of .cr2, .nef, .arw, .dng or .heic files is a wall of pictures again.

    Video

    • NewClips a browser cannot play still get the right shape and facts. AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG and their kind now carry their true length and dimensions.
    • FixVideo previews appear on Android phones and on Firefox. A clip used to land as a blank card there, a phone's own camera footage being the exact case that failed.
    • FixPhoto-heavy boards no longer run older iPhones and iPads out of memory. The picture-shrinking that keeps a big board inside a tab's memory had stopped working on Safari before 16.4.
    • FixEmptying the bin actually frees the space. A deleted file's data used to travel on inside the board and be written into every save afterwards.

    0.206 - 0.234

    Every Corner

    15 August 2026

    • The app was read end to end against its own stated intentions, and the places where the two had come apart were repaired. One thing was added along the way.

    The one new thing

    • NewA multi-select mode, for a finger. While it is on, a tap on a card adds it to what is picked rather than replacing it, and nothing you do to the board underneath clears the selection. It ends from the row it was started from, from Esc, or from opening another board.

    Boards that would not behave

    • FixDeleting a saved board asks first, and names it. It was one tap on a small glyph in the corner of a card whose whole face means Open, with no undo and no bin.
    • FixA board that has lost one file can still be left, where the only way out had been Clear everything.
    • FixReloading while a board is still opening no longer writes a blank one over it.
    • FixTwo boards stashed at once no longer lose one of them, and the shelf is capped at twenty-four.
    • FixA board carrying its own colours keeps them - the note washes, a card's shadow and how far a card leans.
    • FixA save that fails says so, rather than leaving the button reading Saving... for the rest of the session.

    Pictures, PDFs and notes

    • FixPDFs draw on the live site. The reader was fetched from another host, which the site's own security rules refuse, so every PDF and .ai card fell back to grey. It ships with mbrd now.
    • FixA note keeps its alignment and its markers through an export and a re-import.
    • FixA handful of files that could stop the tab cannot any more - a model asking for more memory than the machine has, a picture claiming thirty thousand pixels a side, a note with a long run of backticks.
  15. 10

    0.196 - 0.205

    Every Step

    14 August 2026

    • The Timeline arrived - every change to the board as a step you can go back to - and a picture opened from the board learned to zoom.

    The Timeline

    • NewThe Timeline, under System, is every change to the board as a step you can go back to, and it lives in the board file rather than in the tab, so it is still there tomorrow.
    • NewA step can be given a name, and a named step is a landmark you can find again months later.
    • NewAn align, a distribute or an arrange can be changed after the fact, and everything you did after it happens again on top of the new answer.
    • NewThe Timeline offers to fold steps older than thirty days into the starting point, leaving the board unchanged.
    • NewExporting asks whether to send the history with the board, and the answer already under your thumb is to leave it out.

    The picture viewer, and what a board weighs

    • NewA picture opened from the board zooms and pans. The zoom goes to the point under the cursor rather than the middle of the window, so pointing at a face keeps the face.
    • NewA line of a note can be drawn over with a marker, in four colours, the way a highlighter is.
    • NewA crop reshapes the card it is in, so a 16:9 slice of a square photograph stops being letterboxed. The area is held.
    • NewFlip and Flop in the darkroom, mirroring a picture left to right or top to bottom.
    • NewWhat is in this board says where the weight went, counting by kind and naming the ten heaviest files. Pressing a row travels the board to it.
    • NewA style tile, carrying the palette, the faces and a few of the pictures. It is a live card on the board: move the dial and every tile follows.
    • NewA cut-out picture can drop its card, landing on the board as the shape rather than in a box.
    • NewThe board file names its own parts, so a .mbrd renamed to .zip opens with the pictures under the names of the cards they sit on.

    Repairs

    • FixHovering a card animates again, after several releases of it arriving instantly.
    • FixA note no longer sticks to the pointer after you change its face.
    • NewSomething large is asked about before it comes in, once for the whole drop, rather than two minutes into decoding it.
